name: Yosemite
source: Yosemite is the manifestation of Yosemite National Park, and an all around smart aleck. She loves nothing more than to research the history of the parks, and does so in the desperate hope that she can unearth her origins--as well as her own forgotten memories. Being the only one who can outwit her, she often gets into verbal sparring matches with Eve. Regardless, the two share a healthy respect for one another, and Yosemite has taken it upon herself to counter Eve's cynicism with hard logic.
